content: As all translated versions of SQuAD/DRCD are parallel to each other. Given a source-target language pair, we calculate cosine similarity of the mean pooling of tokens representation within corresponding answer-span as a measure of how much they look like in terms of the internal representation of multi-BERT. The results are shown in Fig. FIGREF26.
